_matrixAnalyse: This ad group has exceptionally strong master-level conversion signals. 'Data science master' (60 clk, CVR 15.0%) and 'master data sciences' (14 clk, CVR 17.9%) are the dominant converters — the highest CVRs of any non-niche terms in the full account. 'Data science bootcamp' (7 clk, CVR 14.3%) also converts strongly. 'Data science course' (14 clk, CVR 9.5% and 16 clk, CVR 6.2%) provides volume. Pattern B : 'data engineer' (8 clk, CVR 0%) — adjacent role, different career track, the page does not address data engineering specifically. The page must project postgraduate-level credibility : statistics, ML, Python at depth.
